briefing.headline: Gameweek 11 deadline is Saturday 21 Nov, 11:00 UTC, and João Pedro, Gvardiol and Virgil are the big flags to check before you transfer.

points.text: The Gameweek 11 deadline is 21 November 2026 at 11:00 UTC.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: João Pedro (31.2% owned) has a thigh injury with an unknown return date. He is also the most sold player.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Gvardiol, Virgil, Guéhi, Belloumi and Manzambi are all flagged at 75% chance of playing.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: N. Jackson, Evanilson and Barry are the most bought players. Gabriel, Rice, Konsa and N. Jackson are price risers.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Several guides say Jackson is the better captain over Haaland against Sunderland.
